item.title: Learning Perturbation Robust Policies for LLM Agents with Stable Optimization
item.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective post-training paradigm for long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents. However, we find that the resulting policies can be sensitive to various policy perturbations, such as hidden-state noise, pruning, and quantization.

item.description: In recent years, humanoid loco-manipulation has progressed to whole-body grasping, lifting, and transport. item.title: Implementing rapid reset of superconducting qubits with on-chip dissipation
item.description: Rapid and high-fidelity qubit reset is essential for quantum state initialization and quantum error correction. Conventional reset protocols for superconducting qubits often rely on dissipative elements connected to external circuitry, exposing qubits to thermal noise from higher-temperature environments.

item.description: Pose and motion priors play a crucial role in humanoid robotics. item.title: Embodied First Exam
item.description: Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots. Existing robotics benchmarks are built around visuomotor policy learning, leaving it open whether coding agents can reliably control diverse robots under physical-world constraints.
